What's new in 3.3.1

Dax is now signed and notarized under a new Apple Developer account. Nothing about how Dax works has changed, but macOS treats an app from a new signer as a new app, so you will see a few one-time prompts after this update.

What to expect after updating

  • macOS may ask for Dax's permissions again. Accessibility, Screen Recording, Microphone and Camera are remembered per signer. Approve them once in System Settings → Privacy & Security and they stay.
  • You may be asked to allow Dax in Login Items. That is the lid daemon, which now trusts the new signature.
  • Your Keychain may ask once whether Dax can use a saved item. Choose Always Allow.
  • Your tabs, settings, characters and files are untouched.

Around the app

  • Signed, notarized, universal (Apple Silicon & Intel), macOS 14+.
